event_commands.string: DINCE
Hi. You must be new here. I'm Dince, an
apprentice Defender. Just one more year
until I'm 18 and can take the Trials!
TALAN
Oh, I didn't know there was an age
requirement.
DINCE
Yeah... if you're born here, like I was, then
you get to stay until you're 18 before you
need to take the Trials.
DINCE
I'd better pass them, too - I'm not very good
at forging armor, so I always get yelled at.
DINCE
I guess I should keep working.
DINCE
Oh, hello again. I heard that you've been
accepted - congratulations!
TALAN
Thanks.
DINCE
Take my advice and don't become a
Defender - my master is a lunatic! He
expects me to have this forged by tonight!
The half-forged armor melts into a
puddle in the fireplace.
DINCE
Oh no! Drat!
TALAN
I'd better leave him alone for now.

DINCE
This metal doesn't want to cooperate.
<sigh>
DINCE
I need to finish this armor before I
can go to the play tonight! Oh, man!
EMILY
She can't die!
PIERSON
Hurry to the marshes and find the antidote!
Isabella doesn't have very much time...
PIERSON
You need to rescue Drago from the hidden
bandit hideout somewhere to the north!
PIERSON
I don't like this at all... that bandit raid was
too unusual. I think something suspicious
is going on...
EMILY
How is she?
PIERSON
The arrow was coated with Gnashtooth
poison - she doesn't have very long to live.
EMILY
Is there an antidote?
PIERSON
You're the expert, Radin. Is there an
antidote for Gnashtooth?
RADIN
The only known antidote for this toxin
is a powder made from the tongue of a
Murgator - and they're very dangerous.
TALAN
We have to do something! Isabella will die
if we don't!
EMILY
If Drago were here, he'd have already
found a Murgator, killed it, and given
her the antidote!
PIERSON
It is unfortunate that the bandits captured
Drago - and highly unusual: they've never
taken prisoners before. I was also not aware
PIERSON
that they had access to Gnashtooth.
RADIN
The Defenders have already left to
rescue Drago. Maybe they'll get him
back in time to find the antidote?
PIERSON
That is a possibility.
EMILY
We can't just wait around for them
to get back! We need to find the
antidote NOW!
PIERSON
TALAN
What if Radin and I are able to find
a Murgator - would we be able to
save Isabella?
PIERSON
Do you know where to find this antidote?
RADIN
The Ill Marshes to the south would be
an ideal environment for Murgators... but
there's no guarantee that any live there.
TALAN
We have to try, even if there's only
a slight chance...
PIERSON
Very well. Radin and Talan, good luck.
And keep this quiet - I don't want to cause
any more of a panic.
RADIN
We should outfit ourselves before we leave.
The swamp is far to the south, and Murgators
are very dangerous.
PIERSON
I hope Radin and the other Farmers can
find the antidote quickly. The poison on
this arrow... is very rare.
SERN
Permission to lead a corps of Defenders
against the bandit hideout, Sir?
PIERSON
I don't know, Sern. This whole raid was
unusual. I think it might be a trap.
EMILY
But Drago's been captured by the bandits!
We have to get him back... that's what
Isabella would want!
PIERSON
I know, Emily, I know. But the bandits have
never taken prisoners before, and their
arrows have never been poison-tipped.
PIERSON
If we send all of our Defenders to get
Drago back, Paradise will be defenseless.
We can't risk it.
PIERSON
This feels like a setup.
TALAN
Sern and I could go. Leave the rest of the
Defenders here, and the two of us could
get Drago back!
PIERSON
Out of the question. We need -
SERN
The boy has a point. We might be able to
get in without being noticed. We could
have Drago back within a few hours.
EMILY
You let those farmers go looking for the
antidote for Isabella. Drago deserves
the same - He needs to be rescued!
EMILY
Saving just one isn't good enough - because
without each other, Drago and Isabella would
rather be dead! I just know it.
PIERSON
PIERSON
Sern and Talan, it looks as if it's up to you.
The bandit hideout is somewhere to the
north. Bring Drago home to us.
SERN
We should outfit ourselves before we leave.
Who knows what we'll have to face up north?
wb3town
DEFENDER
Dince's heart is in the right place, but
he can't seem to master the art of
forging.
RADIN
I can't find ingredients here.
